scope: Grok reviewer admission, observational tool selection, repository identity, settling and quota recovery
changes: Allow only read, grep and glob tools; pass the diff from the parent and use an environment allowlist.
Require repository writer permission before inference and again before posting. This is a trusted-contributor tool, not filesystem isolation.
Use escaped XML prompt fields and reject diffs larger than 256 KiB.
Skip overlapping invocations with a nonblocking file lock.
Namespace clones, worktrees, saved reviews and watch state by repository; retain the legacy lapis state and preserve the selected repository in LaunchAgent arguments.
Preserve NUL-separated filenames and Git diff header quoting, including spaces, tabs, newlines and Unicode.
Pin each watcher review to its settled head before checkout; moved heads neither publish nor consume an attempt.
Persist an account-wide quota deadline until the next local day, skip all repositories during that deadline, and keep non-quota per-head retries available.
Replace the rejected grok-4.7-build-fast model pin with live-catalog grok-4.7; no automatic model fallback.
